column3: “Someone treads down it” is rendered “it is stamped firm.”
The written text has “me” throughout (“devoured me”); “confused” is rendered “crushed,” and “sea monster” as “monster.”
“Conduct your case” is rendered “plead your case,” and “avenge your vengeance” as “exact full vengeance.”
“Heaps of stones” is rendered “a heap of ruins.”
“Celebrate” is rendered “become jubilant”; the LXX reads “be stupefied.”
“A waste” is rendered “an object of horror.”
“Images” is rendered “idols,” and “fatally wounded” as “mortally wounded.”
“A sound will be given” is rendered “The tumult of their voices sounds forth.”
“Son of Mahseiah” is rendered “grandson of Mahseiah.”
